title: conasMatedPair
description: One record of the shared CONAS mated-pair registry (approved 2026-08, ABT #470). RATIONALE: IEC 62153-4-15 §3.7 defines the shielding DUT as 'connector with mating connector and attached connecting cables' — so screening attenuation, transfer impedance and channel S-parameters are structurally properties of a PAIR (sometimes a pair plus a cable assembly), never of a single part. A per-part 'shielded' boolean or a per-part dB figure asserts something the governing standard does not define; this registry is the honest container: a small number of well-attributed pairs with real published evidence, alongside hundreds of thousands of parts that correctly say nothing. Stored one-per-line as NDJSON (data/conas-mated-pairs.ndjson), referenced from tooling by pairId. Evidence entries POINT at the rights holder's publication (pointer-only, like sParameterReference) — nothing is hosted, nothing is synthesized, and absence of a record here is information, not a gap to be back-filled.

cableAssembly.description: When the evidence characterises pair + cable (the IEC 62153-4-15 DUT), the cable assembly it was measured with, as published.

evidence.description: Published measurements/characterisations of this mated pair. At least one — a pair record without evidence has no reason to exist.

method.description: Test method or report class the publication states (e.g. 'IEC 62153-4-15 triaxial cell', 'IEC 62153-4-7 tube-in-tube', 'vendor High Speed Characterization report').

reference.description: URI or unambiguous document identifier of the rights holder's publication. Pointer only — never a rehosted copy.

notes.description: What the publication actually contains (frequency range, S:G patterns covered, edge rate...), so a consumer knows before fetching.

side.title: matedPairSide
side.description: One half of the mated pair, series-level (vendors publish intermateability series-level; a specific partNumber may be named when the evidence is for an exact SKU).
